Both authorize(...) and execute(...) default now=None, and _expired() returns False for a key that DECLARES an expiry (even a PAST one) when no clock is injected. Recommendation for W8 / W11 / live enablement: require now on the two-key CRITICAL path and fail closed if it is absent (or have _expired refuse a declared-but-unverifiable expiry when no clock is supplied), so a future caller cannot silently disable the freshness control.
